page_title: WHU 2-2 NEW | West Ham v Newcastle 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Peter Bankes has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) delivers a fine ball into the box from a free kick. However, the opposition's defence make sure none of his teammates get a challenge in on the goalkeeper.
90+6' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' Peter Bankes blows for a foul after Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+3' Here comes a substitution. Elliot Anderson is given a rest as he is replaced by Matt Targett (Newcastle Utd).
90+2' The linesman signals that Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+2' The corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is intercepted by Nick Pope.

90+1' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! West Ham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 2 Goal! Vladimir Coufal plays a short, square pass into the path of Mohammed Kudus (West Ham), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 2:2. Fabulous goal!
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexander Isak leaves the pitch and Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
85' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
83' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
83' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. West Ham win a corner.
82' Substitution. Miguel Almiron walks off the pitch and Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.
81' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Nick Pope comes off his line to intercept.
80' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
79' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) picks up a yellow card.
76' David Moyes has decided to substitute Tomas Soucek and he is replaced by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham).
75' Today's match ends for Michail Antonio who will be replaced by Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham).
74' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
74' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick, but Alphonse Areola reads it well and stops the effort.

73' OFF THE POST! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
72' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' The whistle blows and Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) is booked for an infringement.
66' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Peter Bankes blows for a foul.

62' 1 - 2 What a goal! Kieran Trippier plays it to Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Alphonse Areola into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
60' The percentage of ball possession is – 28:72.
60' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Newcastle players have a reason to celebrate!
58' The Newcastle players halt their celebrations as referee Peter Bankes makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

57' 1 - 1 Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) takes a great first touch inside the box after the free kick, wins himself some space and beats the goalkeeper with an accurate strike into the left side of the target.
57' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
57' A header by Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) from very close range goes towards the right-hand post, but doesn't get past Alphonse Areola, who makes a brilliant save.
55' It looks like Edson Alvarez (West Ham) saw red with that tackle. Peter Bankes won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
53' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
51' James Ward-Prowse floats a good corner into the box that Edson Alvarez (West Ham) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just wide of the left post.
50' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
49' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
46' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Peter Bankes has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Peter Bankes blows for a foul.
41' A pass by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
38' Michail Antonio (West Ham) is adjudged offside.
37' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' It must be a yellow card. It is. Michail Antonio (West Ham) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
34' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.

32' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches wide of the left-hand post.
31' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) brings an opponent down and Peter Bankes interrupts the game.
29' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
28' A pass by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
25' Nick Pope leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).
24' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
24' Peter Bankes has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd).
23' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) is caught offside!
22' A pass from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola and the move breaks down.
22' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
19' Emerson (West Ham) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
19' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd). Peter Bankes saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
16' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make.
16' Emerson (West Ham) is penalised.
15' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) plays a through ball but overhits it.
14' Rough tackle by Tomas Soucek (West Ham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Newcastle are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) scores after an assist by Emerson that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
7' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) jumps into a tackle and Peter Bankes signals a foul.
6' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
5' Emerson (West Ham) commits a rough foul. Peter Bankes stops the game and makes a call.
4' A lofted pass to the edge of the six-yard box is won in the air by Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd), but his tame header goes well wide of the left post.
3' The ball is cleared after Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
West Ham will kick the game off.
Peter Bankes got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
